0022600200.text: The Bucks host the Celtics in their 10th game of the 2026-27 season, sitting at 1-7 with a four-game losing streak, 15th in the East and 5 games back in the Central, and they are 1-3 at home. Boston arrives at 7-2 on a two-game winning streak, 2nd in the East and half a game back in the Atlantic, with a 5-0 home record and a 2-2 road record. The Bucks trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 109-102 loss in Boston on November 4, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
